frameworks.name: Outcome discovery and ProductSpec
frameworks.problem_owned: Turn a client conversation into an implementation-independent outcome, workflow and acceptance specification.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The same discovery invariants apply across industries: terminal owner, measurable outcome, actors, entities, state transitions, authority, non-goals and acceptance must be explicit before source selection.

ordered_rules: Name the outcome, terminal owner and metric without naming a donor.
Enumerate actors, entities, state transitions and authority boundaries.
Mark each requirement COVERED, UNCOVERED or NEEDS_CLARIFICATION with provenance.
Separate non-goals and the authority ceiling from implementation choices.
Generate executable acceptance examples for the complete workflow.
Hold planning behind a client Accept or Revise gate.

evidence.claim: Sprint 1 records ProductSpec evidence, explicit holds and a client acceptance boundary; the five-workflow proving harness remains unrun.
The roadmap keeps requirements independent of implementations and makes acceptance a separate experiment gate.

model_judgment: phrasing observed pain as a bounded outcome
proposing entities and workflow questions

falsifiers: A representative workflow cannot be expressed without donor-specific implementation fields.
The authorized five-workflow harness shows the minimum spec omits a field needed for safe composition.
frameworks.next_gate: Create a ProductSpec schema and run the five-workflow acceptance harness with an explicit client gate.

frameworks.name: Business lifecycle and Block Hub decomposition
frameworks.problem_owned: Map business outcomes into reusable block requirements, recipe membership and source-candidate edges without collapsing different abstraction levels.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The lifecycle and six-level vocabulary can organize every future recipe while preserving the distinction between a UI component, surface, capability, product, engine and composition recipe.
outputs: universal, vertical, optional and deferred priorities

ordered_rules: Place the job in acquire, sell, activate, deliver, support, retain, operate, measure or govern.
Classify the requirement at one of six levels: component, surface, capability, product, engine or recipe.
Preserve domain vocabulary, state and authority as a recipe overlay rather than a new universal stack.
Join requirements to candidates without treating membership as qualification.
Mark thin, gap-heavy and deferred rows explicitly.

evidence.claim: The hub defines six levels, the acquire-to-govern lifecycle, a shared foundation and four overlays, with qualification kept separate.
The pilot packet provides a machine-readable dependency and priority map, while explicitly making no product or admission decision.

deterministic: stable block identity and recipe membership
model_judgment: mapping language to a canonical block
proposing candidate source edges
human_authority: accepting a recipe scope or deferral

falsifiers: New recipes cannot reuse the lifecycle and level vocabulary without silently changing ownership semantics.
A requirement classified at one level repeatedly needs two conflicting levels to be safe.
frameworks.next_gate: Run the 17-block representative foundry set and verify that hard dependencies remain closed without promoting candidates.

frameworks.name: Source discovery and candidate funnel
frameworks.problem_owned: Turn a broad source universe into a small, evidence-labelled candidate set for one block and workflow.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The funnel prevents another shallow denominator sweep by fixing the row grain, evidence depth and primary/backup/reference roles for every source family.
outputs: 20-30 credible candidate set when supply is thin
seven linked module records for selected candidates

ordered_rules: Join existing local evidence and retain its evidence class.
Add only enough discovery candidates to cover the block, not an arbitrary global quota.
Read the strongest candidates at product and architecture level.
Separate product, framework, primitive, engine and reference supply.
Select a primary, backup and pattern/reference candidate only after the reuse shape is considered.
Search again only for a named unresolved specialist gap.

evidence.claim: The candidate funnel defines 20-30 credible candidates, five deep reads and primary/backup/reference roles rather than a universal shallow list.
The permanent shelf separates source identity, evidence classes, foundry stage, client precedents and admission state.

model_judgment: finding a relevant source
summarizing capability and seams

falsifiers: A bounded candidate funnel misses a needed capability more often than a broad corpus sweep while consuming more qualified evidence.
The source registry cannot preserve separate discovery, qualification and admission states.
frameworks.next_gate: Add a machine-readable row contract for `(source, block, recipe, workflow, shape)` and run it against one thin and one well-supplied block.

frameworks.name: Product, framework, primitive, surface and engine classification
frameworks.problem_owned: Split a source container into the capability level that can actually be reused, without calling a framework, engine or visual primitive a complete product.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Every source portfolio contains mixed abstraction levels; a controlled classifier prevents product completeness and engine leverage from being averaged into one misleading repository label.
outputs: underdetermined classification when evidence is insufficient

ordered_rules: Preserve source identity before splitting the source container.
Classify as product only when a runnable user outcome and product surface are evidenced.
Classify reusable infrastructure as framework or engine when its product surface is not the value unit.
Classify bounded UI or utility supply as surface, package or primitive.
Split composite repositories into multiple capability candidates when ownership and seams differ.
Return UNDERDETERMINED rather than infer a product level from metadata alone.

evidence.claim: P04 treats the repository as a source container and adds surface and engine kinds because product/framework/primitive distinctions change reuse decisions.
The hub preserves six levels from UI component through composition recipe.

deterministic: required evidence fields for each class
separate source identity from capability identity
model_judgment: reading the source to propose capability boundaries
classifying ambiguous product/framework boundaries
human_authority: choosing to split or preserve a composite source

falsifiers: A single source-level classification predicts reuse value as well as a capability-level split across ten sources.
The classifier repeatedly labels engines as products and causes incorrect selection.
frameworks.next_gate: Encode three P03 candidates at product, surface and engine levels and compare their shape-specific decisions.

frameworks.name: Reuse-shape and ownership selection
frameworks.problem_owned: Choose the correct delivery and ownership shape for a capability before adaptation so mature code is preserved without creating a false fork.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Shape is a repeatable architectural decision across donors; it predicts identity, data, token, runtime and upgrade surgery while remaining distinct from rights exposure.
outputs: shape decision receipt with rejected alternatives

ordered_rules: Pin source identity before evaluating rights or adaptation.
Prefer the least copied shape that preserves the client outcome: service/coordinate before slice or specification-only reimplementation.
If the capability must share host cascade or session, rule out a cross-origin frame.
If it owns durable state or migrations, preserve the donor boundary unless a named authority decision accepts absorption.
Keep reuse_shape (product architecture) separate from rights_exposure (how much source is copied).
Record rejected alternatives; an unrecorded default is not a shape decision.

evidence.claim: P04 separates ten architecture shapes from four rights-exposure values and names shape, migration authority and admission as human decisions.
P07 makes cascade and session coupling a feasibility input to shape selection and bounds cross-origin framing.

model_judgment: proposing a shape from source and host facts
estimating the surgery set

falsifiers: Reuse shape fails to predict the surgery set across five representative donors.
A human and deterministic policy reach the same shape and migration decisions at parity across ten donors.
frameworks.next_gate: Encode three real shelf candidates into the seven-record family and hand-run the shape decision with alternatives recorded.

frameworks.name: Repository Value Matrix and shape-specific Diamond Score
frameworks.problem_owned: Value one source separately for complete-product, surface/module, engine, package and pattern reuse without letting a fatal weakness disappear inside an average.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: A repository can be valuable in one reuse shape and unusable in another; a fixed row grain and shape-specific score make that distinction comparable at corpus scale.
outputs: Diamond Score or explicit UNDERDETERMINED/INELIGIBLE verdict

method.equation: D(shape) = 100 * exp(sum(w_i(shape) * ln(max(s_i / 100, epsilon))) / sum(w_i(shape) for applicable dimensions)); hard gates run before D and unknown required dimensions return UNDERDETERMINED.
ordered_rules: Hold `(source, shape, recipe, block, workflow)` constant; never publish a repository-wide score.
Require pinned identity and classify missing evidence as unknown, never zero or not_applicable.
Apply shape-specific hard gates for rights, identity, tenancy, authority, closure, runtime and recovery.
Mark genuinely irrelevant dimensions not_applicable only from the shape policy, then renormalize weights.
Invert raw cost dimensions into higher-is-better normalized scores while retaining raw costs.
Compute the weighted geometric Diamond Score and retain the minimum critical dimension and gate failures.
Use the evidence ladder and controlled screenshot protocol before comparing product-surface rows.
Keep AFFiNE, Twenty, Chatwoot and Plane as unscored calibration fixtures.

evidence.claim: The pilot packet fixes the row grain, five demand/reuse inputs, shape-specific valuation and the four positive anchors without selecting or admitting them.
The experience packet defines measurable surface dimensions, the VSCP-1 capture protocol and policy thresholds explicitly marked for calibration.

deterministic: hard gates, evidence states and screenshot manifest integrity
model_judgment: extracting dimension signals from source and controlled captures
proposing a shape-specific candidate comparison
human_authority: approving any exception to a hard gate

falsifiers: A weighted arithmetic or the Diamond Score ranks a candidate with a fatal gate failure above a clean candidate.
Repeated controlled captures are not reproducible from the same manifest.
Shape-specific scores do not distinguish a product, surface, engine, package and pattern on held-out fixtures.
frameworks.next_gate: Run the VSCP-1 protocol on the four calibration anchors and a small held-out donor sample; publish scores only with capture, evidence and blocker vectors.

frameworks.name: Seven-record module contract family
frameworks.problem_owned: Keep capability semantics, packaging, host facilities, per-application binding, qualification, registry governance and release recovery linked but independently owned.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The seven records change on different clocks and let a qualification rerun or deployment change without mutating the semantic interface a composer reads.

ordered_rules: Put a field in the record whose owner can change it without invalidating the others.
Keep capability semantics free of runtime, proof, rights and host details.
Require source identity, dependency closure, rights state and upstream sync in packaging.
Make BindingPlan the only record where one module meets one host/application.
Min-gate qualification across orthogonal evidence families.
Scope registry admission explicitly and enumerate release rollback objects.

evidence.claim: P04 records seven owners on seven clocks, five invariants and the split from the monolithic Block Contract.
Sprint 2 convergence adopts the seven-record family and preserves its research-only, unexecuted boundary.

model_judgment: proposing capability boundaries and port semantics
mapping donor facts into a draft record

falsifiers: A composition needs proof or rights fields inside CapabilityContract to decide semantic fit.
A qualification update changes a previously valid capability meaning without a contract revision.
frameworks.next_gate: Run Loop 0 with an intact service, transplanted surface, extracted package, owned capability and connector record set.

frameworks.name: Normalization surgery taxonomy and glue planning
frameworks.problem_owned: Predict and govern the branding, onboarding, identity, tenancy, settings, navigation, data, token, runtime, upgrade and rollback changes needed to bind a source.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The surgery categories and determinism/cost classes provide a common planning vocabulary across donors while exposing boundary and architectural work hidden by line-count optimism.

ordered_rules: Route the source by reuse shape before listing edits.
Enumerate affected concern categories rather than quoting a percentage.
Classify each surgery as deterministic, semi-automatic or human judgment.
Classify cost as cosmetic, boundary or architectural and mark irreversibility.
Apply shape-specific glue budgets; overflow routes to reject, reshape or human review.
Record settings and migration authority as named gates, not cosmetic tasks.

evidence.claim: The current taxonomy contains 28 surgeries across 14 categories with a 7/17/4 determinism split and 3/13/12 cost split.
Three worked traces touch different surgery sets for service, transplant and engine-plus-owned-delta shapes; they remain unexecuted.

deterministic: changed-file/line arithmetic once source is pinned
model_judgment: source seam reading
proposing semi-automatic surgery and affected boundaries

falsifiers: A representative absorption is dominated by cosmetic rather than boundary/architectural work.
The taxonomy cannot predict the different surgery sets for three reuse shapes.
A cross-tenant result is treated as recoverable work rather than a kill condition.
frameworks.next_gate: Measure surgery categories, changed boundaries and repair loops during the first authorized host-absorption pilot.

frameworks.name: Host identity, tenancy, settings and navigation authority
frameworks.problem_owned: Make heterogeneous capabilities behave as one product by centralizing identity, tenant authority, URL space, settings provenance, navigation registration and donor chrome boundaries.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Every assembled product needs the same authority boundary even when each capability retains different implementation, state or router ownership.
inputs: reuse shape and donor chrome constraints

ordered_rules: Trust only host-verified identity and tenant context; reject client-supplied authority headers.
Use host-owned identity and an audience-bound short-lived handoff for federated donors, or delete donor auth only when the code is owned.
Assign one URL owner; let the guest retain only its internal router below a host-assigned basename.
Resolve settings from broad to narrow scopes with explicit combination rule and provenance.
Evaluate entitlement and permission separately; apply cascading emptiness to stripped navigation.
Suppress donor login, tenant switching and top-level chrome through declared, auditable boundaries.
Intersect authority scopes; never union member privileges.

evidence.claim: P10 separates identity, navigation and settings into strong, partial and unprecedented tiers and assigns URL/authority ownership to the host.
The local identity handoff protocol is audience-bound, short-lived, single-use and safe-return-path constrained; adapters remain separate from the protocol proof.

model_judgment: mapping donor identity and settings seams
proposing navigation declarations
human_authority: approving donor chrome and route transitions

falsifiers: A donor can safely mint a session or retain a reachable login/tenant switch without violating the host invariant.
A declarative navigation registry cannot express a real donor without per-donor shell edits.
A settings remount survives a donor upgrade with full parity and no bespoke surgery.
frameworks.next_gate: Build the host settings/navigation registry contract and test identity, route, scope and settings negative paths in Loop 0/3.

frameworks.name: Typed data ownership and migration authority
frameworks.problem_owned: Bind owned, absorbed, federated, event-derived, file and external state without hidden dual writes or a universal-database fiction.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: State classification, one-owner rules and typed ports recur across every capability while allowing donors to keep native stores and migrations.
inputs: state class and source of truth
reuse shape and cross-owner read needs
outputs: typed adapter and read model plan

ordered_rules: Classify each resource as owned transactional, donor-native, event read model, mapping, cache/search, object, external API or secret material.
Assign exactly one authority owner, writer and migration/producer owner for mutable state.
Put tenant identity on every owned resource from the first migration and negative-test isolation.
Use Postgres as the default only for new Actionist-owned transactional state.
Keep donor-native stores behind APIs/adapters; use event-fed read models for cross-owner views.
Keep ORM, physical placement and database-specific behavior inside adapters.

evidence.claim: P09 defines one owner per stateful resource, workload-first store choice, typed data ports, event-fed read models and tenant keys from day one.
SISOCRM provides the local service-versus-own and migration-authority precedent behind the one-owner rule.

model_judgment: classifying donor state and required consistency
proposing adapter and event boundaries

falsifiers: A pilot workflow requires two authoritative writers on one resource.
A thin data port repeatedly leaks ORM or storage semantics across three reuse shapes.
A tenant key and negative test do not prevent cross-tenant reads or writes.
frameworks.next_gate: Specify DataResourceContract and run the four-state-class Loop 2 bake-off with dual-write and tenant-leak probes.

frameworks.name: Closed design grammar and semantic token harmonization
frameworks.problem_owned: Make owned UI, extracted code, native donors and framed services express one validated design language without raw-value or namespace leakage.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: A finite valid grammar and five binding classes can be reused across recipes while respecting the different physics of native CSS, donor variables, selectors and origin boundaries.
outputs: resolved-property, encoding, visual and mode gate receipts

ordered_rules: Route owned/native UI to B1 and extracted/source-owned code to B2.
Route a natively mounted token-driven donor to B3 only when encoding and consumption are known.
Use B4 only for selector-coupled fallback and record upgrade fragility.
Use B5 for hard-origin boundaries and declare its bounded coherence ceiling.
Scope donor variables to the mount container, convert encodings rather than aliasing, and require explicit dark mirrors.
Run identical-first, resolved-property, encoding, visual-coherence and mode-transition gates.

evidence.claim: P07 defines five binding classes, conversion and scope invariants, and runtime gates K-N; all donor experiments remain unexecuted.
The current grammar requires a closed valid pack, explicit modes, semantic roles and no arbitrary interpolation.

model_judgment: donor variable enumeration and role mapping
failure-class classification for source components
human_authority: accepting B4 fragility or B5 bounded ceiling

falsifiers: A planted encoding alias passes the rendered encoding-correctness gate.
A single binding mechanism reaches acceptable coherence across native, compiled and cross-origin donors.
B4 selector overrides survive representative donor upgrades without material breakage.
frameworks.next_gate: Run the three cross-donor experiments and the closed-pack proof against controlled light/dark states.

frameworks.name: Adaptive preference learning and DesignDNA
frameworks.problem_owned: Learn a client's visual preference efficiently from realistic rendered alternatives while shipping only a complete, valid and reproducible token pack.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The comparison, uncertainty, stopping and re-entry rules apply to every design grammar and keep preference selection separate from accessibility and implementation validity.
outputs: nearest valid token pack and alternatives

ordered_rules: Prune the valid design grammar with brand, accessibility, archetype and device constraints.
Show complete realistic screens with only the target dimension varied.
Use four-up plus an explicit outside option as the primary starting arm.
Target the least-resolved dimension or highest-information candidate set.
Stop on confidence/information gain, a five-round floor, a 15-round ceiling or explicit acceptance.
Learn continuous preference coordinates internally but select a closed validated pack.
Re-enter and update DesignDNA from later approvals/rejections rather than treating onboarding as permanent.

evidence.claim: The current protocol defines controlled screens, an outside option, per-dimension confidence, adaptive targeting, closed packs and experiments still required.
P06 derives a 4.04-bit tolerance target and a 5-15 round envelope but records the product choice as unexecuted.

model_judgment: candidate generation inside the closed grammar
interpreting a response and proposing the next comparison
human_authority: choosing a context offset or returning to a dimension

falsifiers: Adjacent grammar levels are not reliably discriminable in the perturbation test.
A static default beats the adaptive protocol on approval, revision count and held-out preference prediction.
A valid pack cannot render representative components and donor surfaces without raw literals or missing roles.
frameworks.next_gate: Normalize the local grammar inventory and run the outside-option, batch-format, correlation, test-retest and static-default experiments.

frameworks.name: Surface and component role mapping
frameworks.problem_owned: Convert raw component tags, previews and donor surfaces into controlled roles with anatomy, states, tokens, responsive behavior and recipe scope.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The same role vocabulary can retrieve visual supply across industries while keeping business capability, data authority and donor provenance separate from appearance.

ordered_rules: Preserve source identity and artifact kind before deduplication.
Use raw tags only as retrieval hints, never as canonical roles.
Separate visual role from business capability and data authority.
Map anatomy, semantic tokens, responsive behavior and required states.
Use source-bearing entries as gated supply and bundle-only entries as reference/preview supply.
Promote a role mapping only after provenance, state and fit review.

evidence.claim: P05 demotes the 75-tag vocabulary to retrieval hints, preserves canonical entities and recommends owning the shell and core primitives.
The experience packet states the raw-tag-to-controlled-role pipeline and separates visual roles from business capabilities.

deterministic: role schema, state and token reference validation
model_judgment: anatomy and role proposal
visual similarity and semantic fit review
human_authority: accepting a role mapping for a client-facing surface

falsifiers: Canonical roles cannot reduce tag ambiguity without hiding important surface differences.
A raw tag match predicts business capability or authority as well as a role contract.
frameworks.next_gate: Create a labeled role sample with state/viewport review and measure perceptual duplicate rate before admitting mappings.

frameworks.name: Archetype shell and navigation topology
frameworks.problem_owned: Choose a workflow-appropriate product shell and responsive destination topology without turning the inherited five-area layout into a universal constraint.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Case consoles, portals, schedules, field operations and learning products need different destination sets but share host-frame, state, responsive and donor-chrome rules.

ordered_rules: Separate L0 host frame, L1 archetype shell, L2 capability navigation and L3 donor chrome.
Select the destination set from the workflow; do not require five areas.
Keep identity, tenant, URL basename and ordering primitives host-owned.
Let donors declare navigation intent while the host assigns route and order.
Preserve destination meaning and primary actions across wide, compact, tablet and mobile profiles.
Use explicit state profiles for rest, loading, empty, error, denied, success, invalid and stale.

evidence.claim: The shell packet provides the host/archetype/capability/donor ownership boundary and rejects a universal five-area shell.
P08 found cross-rail vocabulary pressure under the fixed five-area shell and retained five starting spines as a coverage heuristic, not a schema.

model_judgment: mapping workflow to archetype
proposing destination hierarchy and context surfaces

falsifiers: A fixed five-area shell improves task success across the representative archetype set.
The layered contract cannot host a donor without adopting donor top-level navigation.
Responsive collapse changes permissions, destination meaning or approval reachability.
frameworks.next_gate: Compare SaaS, ecommerce, agency and course-creator shell fixtures with the 17-block representative foundry set.

frameworks.name: Bounded editing and upgrade-safe intent replay
frameworks.problem_owned: Let clients and operators request useful changes without reopening arbitrary code, authority, data or donor-chrome mutation.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Typed edits, semantic anchors, authority cells and replayable intent apply across visual controls, chat, APIs and upgrades while preserving the same safety boundary.

ordered_rules: Accept only text, theme, reorder, add, remove, replace and scoped data-binding verbs.
Anchor by contract slot, semantic role, bridge token, host seam or explicitly priced donor export; forbid coordinates and raw literals.
Resolve through the same authority table as chat, API, migration and upgrade channels.
Return a named refusal with the violated constraint and nearest supported alternative.
Persist version-independent intent separately from disposable version-specific resolution.
Replay intent after upgrade; retain DEGRADED/ORPHANED resolutions and block auto-publish.

evidence.claim: P13 defines semantic edit intent, denial-by-construction, typed outcomes and upgrade-safe replay; no editor runtime was implemented.
The pilot experience contract carries the same seven verbs and explicitly refuses raw CSS, unregistered components, donor login and out-of-scope data binding.

model_judgment: mapping natural language to a typed operation
proposing a bounded alternative
human_authority: approval of a donor or contract transition

falsifiers: Representative client requests leave a large residue that cannot be explained by supported verbs or priced escalation.
Intent replay after a donor upgrade silently changes meaning or authority.
Clients consistently reject bounded edits even when refusal alternatives are clear.
frameworks.next_gate: Compile a real request sample into the seven-verb algebra, then run N edits through an upgrade replay fixture.

frameworks.name: Deterministic composition and UNDERDETERMINED protocol
frameworks.problem_owned: Eliminate incompatible assemblies mechanically, expose missing contract fields and give models only a small set of feasible choices.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The same fixed rules can protect any recipe while separating deterministic compatibility from model selection and human authority.
outputs: first failing constraint and routing gate
bounded candidate set and glue budget

ordered_rules: Evaluate eligibility: scope, rights and evidence.
Evaluate host fit: host version, runtime, data mode and tenancy.
Evaluate closure: port closure, version intersection and port types.
Evaluate exclusivity: namespace, migration owner, identity, navigation, token and observability identity.
Evaluate authority: scope intersection, idempotency and consent.
Evaluate recoverability: rollback object coverage and minimum horizon.
Evaluate shape-specific glue budget.
Return the first named failure; missing meaning-bearing fields return UNDERDETERMINED and zero relaxations are allowed.
method.equation: effective_authority = intersection(host_scope, capability_scopes, resource_scope, approval_scope); recovery_horizon = min(object_horizons).

evidence.claim: P12 specifies 22 ordered rules across seven phases, the three verdicts and the model boundary; no solver implementation exists.
The hand dry-run found and repaired an evidence-family defect; the fixtures remain synthetic and unexecuted by a solver.

deterministic: candidate filtering, scope intersection and version closure
verdict selection, first-failure naming and glue arithmetic
model_judgment: interpreting demand into typed slots
choosing among no more than five pre-verified feasible sets
proposing bounded glue and a reuse shape
human_authority: product equivalence, client acceptance and promotion beyond staging

falsifiers: More than 30% of the fixture checks return UNDERDETERMINED due to contract defects.
Identical inputs produce different verdicts or selected sets across three repeat runs.
The authority-class/session-ladder mapping cannot be derived without a hidden sixth axis.
frameworks.next_gate: Encode three real P03 shelf candidates into the seven records and hand-execute all 22 rules before any model run.

frameworks.name: Evidence qualification and minimum-family gating
frameworks.problem_owned: Qualify a capability and complete workflow without averaging away absent rights, tenancy, security, state or recovery evidence.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Orthogonal receipt families and minimum gating apply to every reuse shape, with profile-specific proof requirements and a workflow gate above the build gate.

ordered_rules: Pin artifact and environment before interpreting a receipt.
Require separate rights, tenancy, security, adaptation, workflow, incident, upgrade, fit and instrumentability families.
Treat absent required families as not_run/unknown; never as not_applicable or zero without a shape rule.
Set tier to the minimum across the required families.
Apply zero-tolerance tenancy/security failures as NO_SHIP.
Run complete workflow acceptance after individual capability checks and keep binding defects separate from capability quality.

evidence.claim: P14 assigns profile-specific receipt families, orthogonality, minimum gating and a workflow gate above build.
P15 carries the same weakest-family rule and zero-tolerance boundary; no live transition has executed.

model_judgment: collecting and classifying source evidence
proposing the applicable profile receipt set

falsifiers: A capability raises its tier by omitting a weak required family.
An individual capability passes while the complete workflow fails and the system attributes the failure to the wrong capability.
A cross-tenant leak is represented as a tiered quality defect rather than NO_SHIP.
frameworks.next_gate: Run profile-specific qualification receipts for the five Loop 0 synthetic records, then add an explicit complete-workflow fixture.

frameworks.name: Tenant-safe connector and external-action authority
frameworks.problem_owned: Reuse provider catalogues and OAuth/action mechanics without inheriting unsafe connection storage or allowing ambient external side effects.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Catalogue, connection, secret, approval, executor, idempotency and receipt concerns recur for every external provider and must remain separate.

ordered_rules: Own the tenant-keyed connection store before importing catalogue breadth.
Keep provider definitions, OAuth mechanics, secrets, executor and action ledger separate.
Pass identity and intended action to the executor; never pass raw provider secrets through the caller.
Check auth and rate limits before idempotency replay and make failure caching an explicit policy.
Require idempotency for writes/side-effecting jobs and a host approval at the declared authority level.
Emit tenant, actor, source, action, receipt, freshness and correlation evidence.

evidence.claim: The host foundation converges on host-owned tenant connections, action receipts and explicit external authority while borrowing catalogue/OAuth mechanics.
The spike exercised provider/action/OAuth mechanics but exposed global connection storage and tenancy failure.

model_judgment: mapping a requested outcome to a provider action
proposing a safe adapter and retry policy

falsifiers: Two tenant scopes can observe or reuse a connection under the same host authority.
A side-effecting action can run without an idempotency key, approval or receipt.
A borrowed catalogue cannot be separated from its unsafe storage layer.
frameworks.next_gate: Run one tenant-safe API-key connector flow with denial, retry, idempotency and read-back receipts before OAuth breadth work.

frameworks.name: Runtime profiles and resource budgets
frameworks.problem_owned: Select an explicit runtime and budget for each capability based on ownership and lifecycle rather than convenience or a one-process fiction.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The five current profiles and resource accounting units apply across every composed product while allowing host-linked packages, browser mounts, donors, workers and schedulers to differ.
inputs: lifecycle: browser, service, queue or timer
outputs: package-in-host, microfrontend, sidecar-service, worker or scheduled-job profile

ordered_rules: Choose sidecar-service for durable donor-owned state/migrations.
Choose scheduled-job for timer-driven work and worker for queue-driven work.
Choose microfrontend for independently built browser surfaces and package-in-host otherwise.
Assign explicit runtime units, managed dependencies, pools and queues.
Check capacity inequalities with reserve and retain raw factors plus confidence.
Refuse dual writers, unknown tenancy, unbounded side effects, missing rollback or capacity overflow; route soft unknowns to review.
method.equation: service_burden = clamp(sidecar_process_count + managed_dependency_count / 2); connection_burden = clamp(5 * peak_connections / capacity.max_connections); decision = refuse if any hard condition, review if soft unknown, otherwise eligible.

evidence.claim: P14 defines five profiles, profile-specific ownership/health/rollback requirements and a deterministic profile lookup; no profile has been executed.
The pilot host blueprint adds resource arithmetic and refusal conditions while labelling fixtures as design estimates.

deterministic: hard refusal and soft review conditions
model_judgment: proposing ownership/lifecycle facts from source evidence
estimating resource factors before measurement

falsifiers: A representative capability needs a sixth runtime profile or the current lookup over-grants ownership.
Measured p95/p99 resources exceed the declared budget after reserve.
Process count or operational cost grows one-for-one with every logical capability despite pooling.
frameworks.next_gate: Replace the resource fixtures with pinned process, RAM, CPU, storage, pool and queue receipts for one mixed-shape composition.

frameworks.name: Release, rollback and recovery horizons
frameworks.problem_owned: Release an exact composition with independently named recovery objects and refuse releases whose minimum recoverability does not meet the declared support window.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Every composition changes code, config, data, routes, donors, secrets, connectors or work in flight; enumerating those objects prevents a boolean rollback claim from hiding an unrecoverable boundary.

ordered_rules: Pin capability, binding, artifact, configuration, data and donor revisions by digest/version.
Retain Actionist-owned artifacts for the declared recovery horizon.
Enumerate code_artifact, configuration, secrets, database_schema, data, donor_revision, surface_route and connector_credential_state objects.
Compute composition horizon as the minimum known object horizon; uncomputable is zero/refuse.
Separate non-recoverable external effects from horizon arithmetic and require compensation or explicit human acceptance.
Rehearse every required object class and never call a partially restored release rolled back.
method.equation: composition_recovery_horizon = min(required_object_horizon_seconds); if support_window > horizon or horizon is uncomputable, release is refused unless a named human override is recorded.

evidence.claim: P14 defines the eight-object rollback vocabulary, minimum horizon and object-level rehearsal requirement; it records no executed rollback.
The P14/P04 reconciliation agrees on digest pinning, retention, minimum horizons and the need to add correlated rollback grouping.

model_judgment: proposing migration and compensation paths
mapping donor mechanisms to rollback objects

falsifiers: Artifact rollback leaves a required object unknown while the release is labelled rolled back.
A composed release needs an object class not represented by the canonical vocabulary.
The minimum horizon does not predict the first unrecoverable object in an induced rollback.
frameworks.next_gate: Run a staged, read-only multi-object rollback rehearsal with one sidecar, one host package and one side-effecting job fixture.

frameworks.name: Per-capability observability and attribution
frameworks.problem_owned: Attribute health, incidents, cost and changes at the finest granularity the runtime boundary can actually observe.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Stable identity, release correlation and trace propagation are required for every profile, while the declared attribution ceiling prevents false learning from coarse telemetry.

ordered_rules: Emit stable capability id, version, environment, owner and health assertion.
Propagate trace, correlation, tenant and release context through requests, events, jobs and actions.
Assign the observed attribution class from the boundary, not from a desired dashboard.
Require cause_group_id for correlated rollbacks or shared failures.
Never demote a capability on a signal finer than its attribution ceiling.
Give unhealthy capabilities a typed user-facing degraded/unavailable surface.

evidence.claim: P14 defines stable capability identity, trace/release context, ownership metadata and a declared attribution ceiling; no production attribution has run.
The host blueprint requires block/runtime/resource/release correlation and redacted tenant context across required signals.

model_judgment: mapping a donor boundary to an instrumentation class
diagnosing a causal group from receipts
human_authority: accepting coarse attribution for a client outcome

falsifiers: A capability cannot emit stable identity without a fork even when the selected shape promises no fork.
Correlated rollback signals still produce multiple independent demotions.
A green host metric hides a failed capability without a typed degraded state.
frameworks.next_gate: Instrument one mixed-shape staged composition and induce dependency, binding and environmental failures with explicit cause groups.

frameworks.name: Registry identity, version, scope and lifecycle
frameworks.problem_owned: Maintain durable capability identity and scoped lifecycle state from source nomination through qualification, admission, supersession and revocation.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Every source/capability needs the same identity-first and fail-closed lifecycle regardless of its packaging shape or client recipe.
inputs: purl, immutable revision and content digest

ordered_rules: Create a durable identity only from a pinned source coordinate, revision and digest.
Keep source, capability, package, binding and release versions distinct.
Record lifecycle and admission scope by tenant, application and environment.
Refuse ambiguous or incompatible rights projection instead of downgrading it to pending.
Resolve dependencies and compatibility against exact versions.
On revocation or supersession, reopen every dependent assembly to held/review.

evidence.claim: The permanent capability shelf keeps source identity, evidence classes, foundry stage, client precedents and admission separate.
P04 makes identity the first blocker, structured admission scope mandatory and ambiguous/incompatible rights non-projectable.

model_judgment: mapping source artifacts to capability identity
proposing supersession and upstream sync relationships

falsifiers: A branch/tag reference is sufficient to reproduce the same source bytes across a release.
Revocation does not reopen dependent assemblies.
Scoped admission is not needed to prevent one tenant or environment from consuming another's capability.
frameworks.next_gate: Join the new registry to one staged BindingPlan and test version, scope, supersession and revocation transitions without execution.

frameworks.name: Production attribution, promotion and retirement
frameworks.problem_owned: Learn from edits, qualification, runtime, incidents, upgrades and client outcomes without rewarding unsafe exploration or misclassifying shared/environmental failures.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: The same signal classes, minimum evidence rule and lifecycle transitions can update any capability, recipe or contract while preserving sparse-data honesty.
outputs: promotion, demotion, retirement and contract backlog

ordered_rules: Classify every observation as quality, environmental, contract_defect, binding_defect or correlated.
Only quality signals with sufficient attribution class may rank or demote a capability.
Collapse correlated observations by cause_id and preserve one shared event.
Keep unknown and no-observation capabilities unproven; never retire on silence.
Promote only after independent observations and minimum critical evidence.
Retire immediately on rights, tenancy or security zero-tolerance breach or explicit operator decision.
Record which assumption a result falsified and route contract defects to the owning framework.
method.equation: rankable_signal = signal_class == quality AND attribution_granularity <= declared_attribution_class; independent_observations collapse by cause_id before thresholds.

evidence.claim: P15 specifies signal classes, min-gated ranking, cause grouping, no-silence retirement and promotion transitions; the current system has zero live observations.
The roadmap requires observed adaptation cost, workflow success, runtime burden, maintenance and client outcome contribution before ranking is trusted.

model_judgment: summarizing an outcome or failure for review
proposing a contract or retrieval change

falsifiers: Environmental credential failures consistently demote otherwise sound capabilities.
Min-gating makes every asset indistinguishable and a calibrated alternative selects better safely.
Cross-client aggregation cannot be authorized, eliminating the proposed learning advantage.
frameworks.next_gate: Run the retrospective min-gated ranking and settle cross-client aggregation consent before consuming any production signal.

frameworks.name: Evidence-producing experiment and stop-gate loop
frameworks.problem_owned: Convert architectural hypotheses into bounded experiments with exact receipts, falsifiers, stop rules and updated decisions instead of restarting broad research.
frameworks.reusable_framework_reason: Every uncertain Actionist seam can use the same six-output loop and explicit proceed, narrow, redesign or stop decision.

ordered_rules: State the assumption and what observation would falsify it.
Choose the smallest authorized experiment that separates the alternatives.
Keep synthetic, source-read, runtime, client and production evidence classes distinct.
Record exact measures, receipts and negative results; do not fill denominators from memory.
Update the contract, adaptation recipe and assumption ledger from the result.
Apply a pre-registered stop/kill rule and choose proceed, narrow, redesign or stop.

evidence.claim: The roadmap defines Loop 0-5, exact measures, stop/kill rules and the required learning outputs for each loop.
Sprint 2 recommends a three-candidate contract-and-solver pilot and explicitly stops before implementation.

model_judgment: forming a testable hypothesis
proposing a minimal experiment and interpretation

falsifiers: Experiments repeatedly produce no decision-relevant measurement or contract change.
A stop rule can be bypassed by relabelling a blocked or unknown result.
Broad research produces more decision value than the smallest depth experiment for the same question.
frameworks.next_gate: Attach a machine-readable experiment receipt to the first Value Matrix calibration and composer dry-run gates.

gaps.title: Host authority registry implementation contract
gaps.consequence: Without a host-owned settings/navigation/identity registry, every composed surface can reintroduce donor login, route or scope ambiguity; the single-product premise cannot be tested.
gaps.current_state: P10 specifies the tiers and P04 carries a HostContract shape, but no portable settings-schema or navigation-contribution framework exists and no host registry has been exercised.
gaps.action: Define HostRegistryContract, settings precedence/provenance, route-ref contribution, two-gate visibility and negative tests for donor chrome.

gaps.title: Complete workflow outcome and attribution contract
gaps.consequence: The system can qualify parts but cannot prove that a selected composition delivered the client's economic or operational outcome, so selection and learning remain ungrounded.
gaps.current_state: ProductSpec has acceptance and P15 has evidence signals, but no canonical outcome receipt joins workflow, client metric, release, capability and consent scope.
gaps.action: Define OutcomeReceipt with terminal owner, metric window, workflow fixture, capability attribution, binding/release IDs, counterfactual/comparison context and privacy scope.

gaps.title: Candidate funnel machine-readable row and query contract
gaps.consequence: Discovery remains a mixture of source registry rows and prose, making shape-specific retrieval, reproducible candidate sets and evidence completeness difficult to automate.
gaps.current_state: The funnel is specified in Block Hub prose and a permanent source registry exists, but the `(source, block, recipe, workflow, shape)` row and query contract are not canonical.
gaps.action: Add a versioned candidate-query/edge schema with evidence class, source identity, shape, block, recipe, workflow, blockers and next gate.

gaps.title: Closed design-grammar candidate catalogue and pack compiler
gaps.consequence: Preference learning can be described but cannot reliably produce controlled, complete, light/dark candidate packs or render the same pack across donor classes.
gaps.current_state: Knowledge/06 specifies the grammar and protocol; P07 supplies semantic/binding contracts; the candidate register, compiler and valid-pack corpus remain absent.
gaps.action: Normalize palette, typography, spacing, shape, motion and component seeds into a versioned grammar register, compiler and gate receipt.

gaps.title: Value Matrix calibration and falsifier run
gaps.consequence: The shape-specific score is a defensible design but cannot yet select or reject a source; a fabricated calibration score would turn anchors into unsupported recommendations.
gaps.current_state: The score schema, weights, equation and unscored anchors are now machine-readable; VSCP-1 and held-out shape comparisons have not run.
gaps.action: Capture AFFiNE, Twenty, Chatwoot and Plane under the same protocol, then test a small held-out set and the planted-failure controls.

gaps.title: Composer execution against real contract records
gaps.consequence: The system cannot yet demonstrate that its 22-rule elimination layer exposes contract defects and blocks incompatible assemblies before model choice.
gaps.current_state: P12 has schemas, 24 synthetic fixtures, hand dry-run traces and smoke receipts, but no executable solver or real P03 candidate record set.
gaps.action: Encode three real shelf candidates, execute all rules three times, report first-failure accuracy, UNDERDETERMINED rate, determinism and vocabulary drift.

gaps.title: Qualification, admission and complete-workflow run
gaps.consequence: All current source and capability rows remain unqualified and unadmitted; the framework cannot show that individual gates plus a whole workflow produce a safe release.
gaps.current_state: T0-T4, profile receipt requirements and release schemas exist, but no source was executed, no workflow passed and admitted modules remain zero.
gaps.action: Authorize one staged read-only binding only after the three-candidate contract pilot; run orthogonal evidence families, negative paths and whole-workflow acceptance.

gaps.title: Runtime density and recovery-cost measurement
gaps.consequence: The stacking model may look efficient on paper while process, RAM, CPU, connections, queues, managed limits and donor recovery burden grow linearly or exceed client support windows.
gaps.current_state: Runtime profiles and a resource-budget schema exist; pilot arithmetic is explicitly a design fixture and runtime density is unmeasured.
gaps.action: Measure a mixed composition in preview/staging with pinned process, memory, CPU, storage, pool, queue, managed-dependency and object-horizon receipts.

gaps.title: Cross-client consent and privacy governance for learning
gaps.consequence: If anonymised cross-client aggregation is not contractually available, the sparse-data learning premise degrades to per-tenant observations and the ranking design changes materially.
gaps.current_state: P15 represents single-client versus aggregated-consented scope, but the operator/client consent policy and aggregation contract are unknown.
gaps.action: Settle contractually permitted aggregation, regulated-workload exclusions, anonymization, retention, deletion and opt-out semantics before live learning.

gaps.title: Release rehearsal and operational promotion loop
gaps.consequence: A static registry page can be searchable while the underlying framework remains unable to promote, revoke, recover or learn from a maintained composition.
gaps.current_state: Release, rollback, attribution and learning schemas are machine-readable; no complete staged release/recovery/promotion cycle has executed.
gaps.action: Run a staged read-only composition through qualification, release lock, induced failure, object-level recovery, revocation and learning receipt checks.
